text:
Iris Park: follow-up from the modularization RFC — proposing a 'stability corridor' approach for multi-week refactors. goal: shrink service surface incrementally while preserving customer contracts. want quick alignment on guardrails.

Ben Hollis: curious what you mean by corridor. is this like a temporary compatibility layer?

Iris Park: yup. corridor = adapter + guarded policy + observability gates. we carve a narrow path for traffic to flow to the extracted module while keeping a fast rollback lane.

Kofi Mensah: sounds good. critical: define the contract freeze and the telemetry contract. otherwise we waste time chasing regressions.

Iris Park: agreed. my proposed guardrails: 1) contract freeze window = 72h pre-cut; 2) telemetry lines: per-route p95, p99, error-rate, and prompt-quality delta; 3) canary ramp: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with soak at each step.

Ben Hollis: For DB-bound pieces we should require a read-only shim and a backfill plan. no dual-write for more than 48h unless pre-approved. keeps migration surface small.

Kofi Mensah: Ops note: make sure the autoscaler profiles and mem limits are tightened for the corridor so side effects are predictable. Also include a cache-warm stage.

Iris Park: yep — add warm stage: replay recent prefixes for 20-40m and synthetic load for 15m before 1% canary.

infra-bot: created ARCH-8081: "stability-corridor: enrichment slice" https://tracker/ARCH-8081

Ben Hollis: what's the rollback fast path? route-level flip + rehydrate caches? or do we reinstate adapter?

Iris Park: fast path = route flip (gateway policy) + toggle feature-flag to point traffic back to the monolith. adapter kept for 14d soft-sunset. if we need to roll back after adapter removed, we rely on snapshot restores + targeted backfill.

Kofi Mensah: propose adding automated gating: if token-cost delta > 20% OR quality degrade > 1.5% for 30m, auto-pause ramp and notify owners.

Ben Hollis: +1. also add a staging canary that uses 100% of a small pilot tenant's traffic to validate end-to-end before public canary.

Iris Park: good call. staging pilot -> public canary. Action items: Ben draft gateway policy + rollback playbook, Kofi draft telemetry gating and HPA profile, I'll write the corridor checklist and API contract addendum. Weekly sync Wed 11.

Ben Hollis: I'll take gateway + rollback. ETA 5d.

Kofi Mensah: I'll own the telemetry gating and HPA. will add dashboards and alert rules.

Iris Park: thanks. If no objections we start the infra spike next Monday. :thumbsup:

Ben Hollis: no objections. :shipit:

Kofi Mensah: ack.

Iris Park: closing thread — will post the checklist and contract snippet in #docs before EOD Fri.
